MinchoCandyWars.StellarisEvent.Stellaris.label: Ruin exploration
MinchoCandyWars.StellarisEvent.Stellaris.title: Qinxintang
MinchoCandyWars.StellarisEvent.Stellaris.desc:
My ally! Do you know where we come from? We may look like some fantasy creature, a slime perhaps, but in truth we are a product of Glitterworld technology, and our main component is the beta nano-shaping organism.
We learned through the info net that this world may hold beta nano-shaping organisms left behind by reclaimed kin. We cannot use them to revive those sisters, but such valuable material can still be used to study ourselves.
All that to say: we hope you can explore a ruin for us, where beta nano-shaping fluid may remain.

li.label: Yes - OK! I love exploring!
li.desc: Accept and head to the ruin to look for beta nano-shaping fluid.

li.label: No - sorry, we cannot help you right now
li.desc: Decline the request. Qinxintang opinion of you will drop.

li.label: Later - hold on, we are working out the route
li.desc: Decide later and close the window. You can contact the Mincho Alliance again afterwards.
